```{r}
europe_extraction <- readRDS("Data/Input/EUROP_tree_extraction_and_pollen_modern.rds")
```

Chunk 1: Initial set up and load data
```{r}
# Definir las columnas target (las de extracción de raster)
target_cols <- c("Tree_Point", "Tree_Buffer_0.75km", "Tree_Buffer_1.5km",
                 "Tree_Buffer_3km", "Tree_Buffer_6km", "Tree_Buffer_12km",
                 "Tree_Buffer_24km", "Tree_Buffer_50km",
                 "Gaussian_0.5km", "Gaussian_10km")

# Identificar las columnas que NO son target (identificadores + taxa)
# Para LATAM
id_cols <- c("id_sample", "entity_name", "latitude", "longitude", 
                   "elevation", "hill_n2")
```



```{r}
#=========== LATAM ========
taxa_cols_latam <- setdiff(names(latam_extraction), 
                          c(id_cols, target_cols))
# Crear una lista de dataframes para LATAM, cada uno con un target diferente
latam_target_list <- list()

for (target in target_cols) {
  # Seleccionar: identificadores + el target actual + todas las taxa
  latam_target_list[[target]] <- latam_extraction %>%
    select(all_of(c(id_cols, target, taxa_cols_latam)))
}



#======= EUROPE ========
taxa_cols_europe <- setdiff(names(europe_extraction), 
                          c(id_cols, target_cols))

europe_target_list <- list()

for (target in target_cols) {
  # Seleccionar: identificadores + el target actual + todas las taxa
  europe_target_list[[target]] <- europe_extraction %>%
    select(all_of(c(id_cols, target, taxa_cols_europe)))
}
```

```{r}
# Procesar toda la lista de LATAM con promediado por lat/lon
latam_prepared <- map2(
  latam_target_list,
  names(latam_target_list),
  ~ {
    df <- .x
    target <- .y
    
    cat("Procesando LATAM -", target, "\n")
    
    # 1. Pivot longer (excluyendo columnas desde id_sample hasta target)
    modern_long <- df %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -c(id_sample:all_of(target)), names_to = "taxa") %>%
      filter(value > 0)
    
    # 2. Filtrar taxa con >= 10 ocurrencias
    taxa_keep <- modern_long %>%
      group_by(taxa) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      filter(n >= 10) %>%
      pull(taxa)
    
    # 3. Re-normalizar y pivot wide
    modern_wide <- modern_long %>%
      filter(taxa %in% taxa_keep) %>%
      group_by(id_sample) %>%
      mutate(value = value / sum(value)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(taxa) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = c(id_sample:all_of(target)),
        names_from = "taxa",
        values_from = "value",
        values_fill = 0
      )
    
    # 4. Seleccionar SOLO columnas numéricas y promediar por lat/lon
    modern_wide %>%
      select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
      group_by(latitude, longitude) %>%
      summarise(across(everything(), mean, .names = "{.col}"), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(id_sample = paste0("ID_", row_number())) %>%
      select(id_sample, everything())
  }
)

# Verificar resultados
names(latam_prepared)
glimpse(latam_prepared[["Tree_Point"]])
```

Extraer componentes para TWAPLS
```{r}
# Extraer componentes para LATAM
latam_twapls_data <- map2(
  latam_prepared,
  names(latam_prepared),
  ~ {
    df <- .x
    target <- .y
    
    # Identificar columnas que NO son taxa (id, coordenadas, y el target)
    id_cols <- c("id_sample", "latitude", "longitude", "elevation", "hill_n2")
    id_cols_present <- intersect(id_cols, names(df))
    exclude_cols <- c(id_cols_present, target)
    taxa_cols <- setdiff(names(df), exclude_cols)
    
    list(
      taxa = df %>% select(all_of(taxa_cols)),
      target = df[[target]],
      coords = df %>% select(longitude, latitude),
      ids = df$id_sample
    )
  }
)

# Extraer componentes para EUROPE
europe_twapls_data <- map2(
  europe_prepared,
  names(europe_prepared),
  ~ {
    df <- .x
    target <- .y
    
    id_cols <- c("id_sample", "latitude", "longitude", "elevation", "hill_n2")
    id_cols_present <- intersect(id_cols, names(df))
    exclude_cols <- c(id_cols_present, target)
    taxa_cols <- setdiff(names(df), exclude_cols)
    
    list(
      taxa = df %>% select(all_of(taxa_cols)),
      target = df[[target]],
      coords = df %>% select(longitude, latitude),
      ids = df$id_sample
    )
  }
)
```

Chunk 1: Extraer componentes para LATAM y EUROPE
```{r}
# Extraer componentes para LATAM
latam_twapls_data <- map2(
  latam_prepared,
  names(latam_prepared),
  ~ {
    df <- .x
    target <- .y
    
    # Identificar columnas fijas (no son taxa)
    id_cols <- c("id_sample", "latitude", "longitude", "elevation", "hill_n2")
    id_cols_present <- intersect(id_cols, names(df))
    
    # El target y las columnas fijas se excluyen de las taxa
    exclude <- c(id_cols_present, target)
    taxa_cols <- setdiff(names(df), exclude)
    
    list(
      taxa = df %>% select(all_of(taxa_cols)),
      target = df[[target]],
      coords = df %>% select(longitude, latitude),
      ids = df$id_sample
    )
  }
)



# Extraer componentes para EUROPE
europe_twapls_data <- map2(
  europe_prepared,
  names(europe_prepared),
  ~ {
    df <- .x
    target <- .y
    
    id_cols <- c("id_sample", "latitude", "longitude", "elevation", "hill_n2")
    id_cols_present <- intersect(id_cols, names(df))
    
    exclude <- c(id_cols_present, target)
    taxa_cols <- setdiff(names(df), exclude)
    
    list(
      taxa = df %>% select(all_of(taxa_cols)),
      target = df[[target]],
      coords = df %>% select(longitude, latitude),
      ids = df$id_sample
    )

)
```

Chunk 2: Configurar paralelización y ejecutar TWAPLS para LATAM

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Número de CPUs
CPUS <- 8

# Ejecutar TWAPLS para LATAM (todos los targets)
latam_results <- map2(
  latam_twapls_data,
  names(latam_twapls_data),
  ~ {
    cat("\n=== LATAM -", .y, "===\n")
    
    taxa <- .x$taxa
    target <- .x$target
    coords <- .x$coords
    
    # 1. Ajuste del modelo
    fit <- TWAPLS.w2(taxa, target, nPLS = 5, 
                     usefx = TRUE, fx_method = "pspline", bin = 0.08)
    
    # 2. Matriz de distancias
    dist_mat <- get_distance(coords, cpus = CPUS)
    
    # 3. Pseudo‑sitios para validación cruzada
    pseudo <- get_pseudo(dist_mat, target, cpus = CPUS)
    
    # 4. Validación cruzada - USANDO la sintaxis de tu código original
    cv_res <- cv.pr.w(taxa, target, nPLS = 5,
                      TWAPLS.w2,           # fit.fun (posicional)
                      TWAPLS.predict.w,    # pred.fun (posicional)
                      pseudo = pseudo,
                      usefx = TRUE,
                      fx_method = "pspline",
                      bin = 0.08,
                      cpus = CPUS,
                      test_mode = FALSE) %>% pb()
    
    # 5. Test aleatorio de permutaciones
    rand_test <- rand.t.test.w(cv_res, n.perm = 999) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(comp = row_number())
    
    # 6. Mejor componente
    best_comp <- rand_test %>%
      filter(p < 0.01) %>%
      slice_min(RMSEP) %>%
      pull(comp)
    
    if (length(best_comp) == 0) {
      best_comp <- rand_test %>% slice_min(RMSEP) %>% pull(comp)
      cat("  -> Ningún componente significativo, se usa el de menor RMSEP (comp", best_comp, ")\n")
    } else {
      cat("  -> Mejor componente:", best_comp, "\n")
    }
    
    # 7. Observados vs predichos
    obs_pred <- data.frame(
      Observed = cv_res$test.x,
      Predicted = cv_res[[paste0("comp", best_comp)]]
    )
    
    # 8. Métricas
    rmsep <- sqrt(mean((obs_pred$Observed - obs_pred$Predicted)^2))
    r2 <- cor(obs_pred$Observed, obs_pred$Predicted)^2
    
    performance <- tibble(
      region = "LATAM",
      target = .y,
      best_comp = best_comp,
      n_samples = length(target),
      RMSEP = rmsep,
      R2 = r2
    )
    
    list(
      target = .y,
      region = "LATAM",
      cv = cv_res,
      rand_test = rand_test,
      best_comp = best_comp,
      obs_pred = obs_pred,
      performance = performance
    )
  }
)



```






```{r}
# Ejecutar TWAPLS para EUROPE (todos los targets)
europe_results <- map2(
  europe_twapls_data,
  names(europe_twapls_data),
  ~ {
    cat("\n=== EUROPE -", .y, "===\n")
    
    taxa <- .x$taxa
    target <- .x$target
    coords <- .x$coords
    
    # 1. Ajuste del modelo
    fit <- TWAPLS.w2(taxa, target, nPLS = 5, 
                     usefx = TRUE, fx_method = "pspline", bin = 0.05)
    
    # 2. Matriz de distancias
    dist_mat <- get_distance(coords, cpus = CPUS)
    
    # 3. Pseudo‑sitios
    pseudo <- get_pseudo(dist_mat, target, cpus = CPUS)
    
    # 4. Validación cruzada
    cv_res <- cv.pr.w(taxa, target, nPLS = 5,
                      TWAPLS.w2,
                      TWAPLS.predict.w,
                      pseudo = pseudo,
                      usefx = TRUE,
                      fx_method = "pspline",
                      bin = 0.05,
                      cpus = CPUS,
                      test_mode = FALSE) %>% pb()
    
    # 5. Test aleatorio
    rand_test <- rand.t.test.w(cv_res, n.perm = 999) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(comp = row_number())
    
    # 6. Mejor componente
    best_comp <- rand_test %>%
      filter(p < 0.01) %>%
      slice_min(RMSEP) %>%
      pull(comp)
    
    if (length(best_comp) == 0) {
      best_comp <- rand_test %>% slice_min(RMSEP) %>% pull(comp)
      cat("  -> Ningún componente significativo, se usa el de menor RMSEP (comp", best_comp, ")\n")
    } else {
      cat("  -> Mejor componente:", best_comp, "\n")
    }
    
    # 7. Observados vs predichos
    obs_pred <- data.frame(
      Observed = cv_res$test.x,
      Predicted = cv_res[[paste0("comp", best_comp)]]
    )
    
    # 8. Métricas
    rmsep <- sqrt(mean((obs_pred$Observed - obs_pred$Predicted)^2))
    r2 <- cor(obs_pred$Observed, obs_pred$Predicted)^2
    
    performance <- tibble(
      region = "EUROPE",
      target = .y,
      best_comp = best_comp,
      n_samples = length(target),
      RMSEP = rmsep,
      R2 = r2
    )
    
    list(
      target = .y,
      region = "EUROPE",
      cv = cv_res,
      rand_test = rand_test,
      best_comp = best_comp,
      obs_pred = obs_pred,
      performance = performance
    )
  }
)
```

```{r}
# Combinar performances de LATAM y EUROPE
all_performance <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(latam_results, ~ .x$performance),
  map_dfr(europe_results, ~ .x$performance)
)

# Ver tabla completa
all_performance %>%
  arrange(region, RMSEP) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Gráfico de RMSEP
library(ggplot2)
all_performance %>%
  mutate(target = factor(target, levels = target_cols)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = target, y = RMSEP, fill = region)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Comparación de RMSEP entre proxies de cobertura arbórea",
       subtitle = paste("n =", nrow(all_performance), "combinaciones"),
       x = "Proxy", y = "RMSEP") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Gráfico de R²
all_performance %>%
  mutate(target = factor(target, levels = target_cols)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = target, y = R2, fill = region)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Comparación de R² entre proxies de cobertura arbórea",
       x = "Proxy", y = "R²") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Gráfico de R² vs RMSEP
all_performance %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = R2, y = RMSEP, color = region, shape = region)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = target), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5) +
  labs(title = "Relación entre R² y RMSEP",
       x = "R²", y = "RMSEP") +
  theme_bw()
```

Chunk: Graficar observado vs predicho para todos los targets (LATAM)
```{r}
# Función para crear gráficos de todos los targets de LATAM
walk2(
  latam_results,
  names(latam_results),
  ~ {
    p <- ggplot(.x$obs_pred, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, color = "darkgreen") +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 0.7) +
      coord_fixed() +
      labs(title = paste("LATAM -", .y),
           subtitle = paste("RMSEP =", round(.x$performance$RMSEP, 4),
                            " | R² =", round(.x$performance$R2, 4),
                            " | Componente:", .x$best_comp)) +
      theme_bw()
    
    print(p)
  }
)
```
